decision: P0 instrumentation and safety boundary are in place. P1 direct safe-copy did not survive reversed-order measurement. P2 supplies frozen command traces. P3 completed exact fixed/bitsliced/int4/ternary and distance scalar oracles; no unchanged-trace candidate approaches the 0.05 artifact budget. P5 recent-distance and hash-miss-only probes were removed. P5 bounded metadata entropy, byte literal entropy, fixed 8-byte tokens, nested literal VXG, direct structural-byte grammar, exact record-template grammar, generic XOR/subtract identifier delta analysis and P5D structured-column modeling are costed evidence. P5D R9 reconstructs every byte but reaches only 0.083904 bursty, 0.078592 event and 0.050617 field-order at 64 MiB; its generic GF(2) predictor selected zero columns. It fails the ratio gate and is not a v3 route. P6B's exact bit-sliced group packet reaches only 37.971M replay commands/s versus the necessary 352.350M, so its scalar stop gate fails and a Neon transpose is rejected. P6P retains the only successful new v2 execution improvement: a profile-justified bounded non-overlap copy more than doubles JSON safe prepared decode in reversed order, but all Q95 speed and all current ratios remain below the joint gates. P6E shows allocator/arena and NEON LCP micro-controls lose their byte-identical local controls, so none is retained. No currently authorized generic candidate has a route to the joint target. On 2026-09-21 the user revised the target to ratio <=0.06 and safe decode >=12 GB/s (15 stretch), retaining 4 GB/s encode. The previous 5% stop decisions are historical; current_target and docs/TARGET_4_006_12_15.md govern further work. Existing P5D packets pass ratio alone on JSON/field-order, but event/bursty and production speeds still fail.
next_step: Retry the corrected energy runner in the user's authenticated terminal into P8-energy-r2; no codec energy measurements completed in R1. Keep heavy work separate from sensor runs. For ratio, the per-value hex-period model is rejected (529,045 extra bytes versus the common-period reference); next test a bounded generic conditional model across serialized values/lengths with prefix training, held-out predictions and full descriptor/escape costs. The required event/bursty savings remain 1,247,677/1,604,179 bytes at 64 MiB. Keep frozen corpus and same-artifact tests; do not combine scalar oracle ratio with v2 speed.
